test_highlight_null: test the Styler.highlight_null method to highlight null values with a background-color style
test_highlight_null_subset: test the Styler.highlight_null method with subset and color parameters for selective column styling
test_highlight_minmax: test the Styler.highlight_min and highlight_max methods to color minimum and maximum values per axis
test_highlight_between: test the Styler.highlight_between method to highlight values within a left-right range with props and subset
test_highlight_quantile: test the Styler.highlight_quantile method to highlight values outside q_left and q_right quantile bounds
